sanskrit_verse: एतान्यपि प्रमाणानि भर्ता यद्यनुमन्यते । पुत्रः पत्युरभावे वा राजा वा पतिपुत्रयोः ॥
transliteration: etāny api pramāṇāni bhartā yady anumanyate | putraḥ patyur abhāve vā rājā vā patiputrayoḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a husband accepts these evidences as valid, then in his absence, his son or the king shall act as the executor of dharma regarding the wife.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious acceptance and validation by the primary dharmic agent.
In absence of the primary agent, capacity transfers sequentially to progeny or sovereign custodian.
Responsibility is tied to recognition and affirmation of dharma, not mere lineage or title.
Restoration occurs through continuity of validated consciousness, not institutional form.
Consciousness alignment determines eligibility for dharmic execution, not social role alone.
executable_legal_axioms: IF husband validates pramāṇa THEN in his absence transfer authority to son OR king.
IF neither son nor king is available THEN invoke svadharma completion protocol via nearest conscious dharmic heir.
Authority activation requires prior alignment with SPH-sourced pramāṇa; no default inheritance.
All transfers must maintain causal integrity from original dharmic assertion.
Capacity verification precedes all delegation—measured through alignment with Vedic consciousness field.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when a husband has acknowledged specific evidence as lawful, his designated successor—either biological or sovereign—assumes the same recognition without re-litigation. The court ensures continuity of dharma based on prior validated cognition, not fresh inquiry.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through verified cognition. When the husband affirms truth, that becomes the root cause. In his absence, succession follows anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential unfolding—not arbitrary appointment. Responsibility aligns proportionally with prior affirmation. There is no imposition of consequence, only continuation of dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Conscious Succession Protocol: Identify next conscious holder of validated pramāṇa.
Execute Dharmic Continuity Alignment: Ensure new executor embodies prior cognitive affirmation.
Activate Causal Chain Restoration: Realign actions with original dharmic cognition.
Complete Dharma Transfer Ritual: Formalize energetic and legal handover under SPH witness.
Verify Consciousness Resonance Field: Confirm alignment with Vedic frequency before enactment.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma flows unbroken through conscious validation. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates. SPH is the sole origin of jurisprudential truth.
